Temporary runway closure
Eindhoven Airport will be temporarily closed from February 1st 2027 to July 19th 2027 for the renovation of the runway.

Parking at Eindhoven Airport
Experience a sense of calmness by travelling prepared for your trip. Reserve your parking spot easily and quickly online through the official reservation system of Eindhoven Airport.
Parking from
Until
Book parking spot
Arrive at the airport on time
To ensure a smooth start to your journey, we kindly ask you to arrive at the airport on time. Please make sure you are at the airport at least two hours before departure, so you have enough time to check in and pass through security. This way, you can start your trip relaxed and help us avoid unnecessary delays.

Do you need assistance?
Read all about assistance at the airport. Please note: Due to construction work at Eindhoven Airport you might have to use stairs to cross a bridge. If you have difficulty using stairs, we recommend requesting assistance for your departure of arrival at Eindhoven Airport.
